name: Vault of Ironforge
summary: In Ironforge's Commons, citizens and Alliance travelers entrust their wealth to the Vault. Dinita and the Stonemantle family oversee its work.

sections.title: Heart of Dwarven Commerce
sections.body: Travelers, soldiers, and merchants bring coin, relics, and provisions to the Vault for safekeeping. City guards and tellers watch the deposits, keeping the wealth of citizens and Alliance visitors secure within the mountain.

faq.q: What is the Vault of Ironforge used for?
faq.answer: The Vault keeps gold, gear, and prized possessions safe within the mountain. Citizens and Alliance travelers rely on it as Ironforge's central bank and treasure storehouse.
Dinita and members of the Stonemantle family operate the bank. They manage deposits, transactions, and storage for visitors.
The Vault is in Ironforge's Commons, directly across from the Auction House.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can take pride in the Vault's reputation for safeguarding dwarven wealth within the mountain.
Across from Ironforge's Auction House, the Vault helps Alliance adventurers keep their gold and supplies close at hand.
